description: Lab apps' image digests move as soon as their image changes and merge on green checks (the Renovate App bypasses the code-owner ruleset); platform updates (Argo CD, Kyverno, KSOPS, actions) wait for a code owner's review.

packageRules.description: Lab apps: digest bumps of ghcr.io/thomas-lg-lab/* in apps/*, at any time, auto-merged when validate is green.
Platform: reviewed by a code owner, never auto-merged.
